name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon crouches on a broken pillar above its treasure, wings half-spread against the storm, head raised and turned toward the camera with a fierce, electric gaze.
components.background: the ruined stone temple of a high mountain peak, towering dark storm clouds behind, forks of lightning striking distant crags, wind-torn banners on broken columns
components.hoard: heaps of gold and copper coils, glassy fulgurite formations fused by lightning, tuning forks and bronze bells, silver ingots, citrine gems and a few crackling crystals
components.effects: A few small sparks of static dance across the hoard - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
